<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 8+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Cordelia's Construct Key](/Equipment.aspx?ID=884)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 123

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Worn on a necklace, this intricate key grants you greater facility with [constructs](/Traits.aspx?ID=35). The key alerts you to constructs lurking around you. Whether or not you are [Investigating](/Actions.aspx?ID=516), the GM automatically rolls [secret](/Traits.aspx?ID=142) [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) checks for you when you see a construct pretending to be a normal object, statue, or the like. Typically, this check is [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4), or an appropriate [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) skill. On a success, you recognize the presence of the construct and gain the usual benefits of Recall Knowledge.

 While you're wearing the key, if your attack reduces a construct to 0 Hit Points, instead of destroying it completely, you can send it into a dormant state, from which you can study its inner workings and possibly (at the GM's discretion) spend time and money to reprogram or repurpose it. Even if you don't subvert it, you can [Repair](/Actions.aspx?ID=42) a construct rendered dormant this way, allowing you to return tomb guardians to their vigil after you've battled them. Additionally, you can activate the key in two ways to call a construct to serve you.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You turn the key in the air and create a magic glyph. The key casts 3rd-level [_summon construct_](/Spells.aspx?ID=318).

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 1 minute (command, envision, Interact);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You place the key on a Small object and turn it, creating a simple animated object for 1 hour. The animated object has the statistics of an [animated broom](/Monsters.aspx?ID=18) but has no bristles Strike and can't attack. It performs simple and broad menial tasks for you in exploration or downtime but is too slow to react to individual commands to assist you in a combat encounter.

</column>

>
Cordelia's Construct Key
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 123

**Price** 450 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 12"
pfs="Standard"
>
Cordelia's Construct Key (Greater)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 123

**Price** 1,750 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

</column>

---

A greater key allows you to fully comprehend and thus partially bypass a construct's resistances. You ignore the first 5 resistance a construct has against your damaging effects, whether martial or magical. Additionally, the key's first activation casts a 5th-level _summon construct_, and its second activation lasts 8 hours.
name: Cordelia's Construct Key (Greater)
